name: The Cross
overview: The cross stands at the heart of the Christian faith, symbolizing both the sacrifice of Jesus Christ and the call to discipleship. Scripture reveals that Christ’s death was the ultimate expression of God's love, giving His Son so believers might have eternal life (John 3:16) and declaring 'It is finished' upon completion of His redemptive work (John 19:30). Believers are called to take up their own cross daily, denying themselves and following Jesus (Mark 8:34), living by faith in the Son of God who gave Himself for them (Galatians 2:20). The cross shapes the believer’s identity, as Paul affirms that true glory is found only in the cross, which separates them from the world (Galatians 6:14), and it invites them into fellowship with Christ’s sufferings and resurrection power (Philippians 3:10).
